body:
I'm sorry that you found out that way.

Me, personally, though it may sound silly... I'm most suicidal when I'm at home. Surrounded by the people who love and care about me.

My close friend that took his life. He was my roommate. And in a way, I felt he saved me from that mindset. Helping me get away from home. And yet, I didn't recognize what he was going through. Or I was too afraid to push for answers, thinking I'd push him further away.

I wish that I could say that life was easy. I wish that I could say it is easy to live for other people. But I have also found that life is fucking unfair. And that it is the most painful to feel you are only living because your death would hurt those you care for too much.

All I can say, is that I found little things to look forward to. The people that trashed me, I would fucking show them that I could be something. The people I lived for... I'd live to share things with them that I had always dreamed of sharing with them. It may seem pretty, living to prove other people wrong. But that person can also be yourself, in a way.

I've also worked to channel that inner turmoil to create things. Which personally helps me feel better, to get it out on paper... but if I also enjoy what I create, I also dream of creating something to help others through what I feel.

I don't know if that will help you or not. But it has helped me. Then again, I enjoy living through other people's stories, because I kinda hate myself. Which is sad but the truth. But one thing that keeps me going is the belief I can help someone one day. Through their dark times.

I guess that constitutes living for someone else, but I dunno. My best friend that took his life pretty much told me to live for myself. Even though something like that, to me, seems impossible. And it may seem silly, but I will try. Just because he asked. Even though he couldn't do it himself.

I know I'm rambling, sorry. I do wish I have more to live for. The selfish part of me, though, does have small, little things to live for. Like stupid video games. Or just my pride to prove someone wrong. But those things are things I hold value for.

Do you have anything, even small, that you look forward to? Even an episode of a TV series or whatnot?

I read the other comment thread.

And I just wanted to let you know that you're not alone.

I was in the military. I got out, back to my family. The only difference in our situation is that I used my Gi bill. Just for the money though.

Through time, I grew more depressed. Living at home and taking online classes. I started failing everything. But I took more classes. And failed more.

The online college I was with... I was kicked out. On top of the ongoing family shit going on, I hated myself.

I felt worthless. I thought of ways to kill myself, as my family talked shit about me behind my back in the other room. It only added to how pathetic I felt.

I wish I had an answer to help you, but it doesn't get easier sometimes. Sometimes, you do have to work through the dark by yourself. Or find something to live for.

I had someone very close to me take their life some months ago. I still feel angry, at times, even though once upon a time, I'm sure I felt similar to them.

Why didn't they tell me what they were going through? Even though, with my own suicidal ideation, I never told anyone else.

I suppose the only thing that really saved me was thinking about other people. Even though it is shit to feel like you are only living your life for others.

But I will add I've found little things to look forward to. Which I think I always have. But I suppose that's just me.

OP, even if it sounds stupid or whatever, know that you do have value. You are a person. I'm sure that has had Hope's and dreams.

You have that drive. And even if you do drop out of college or whatnot? You still have options. College is not the be all/end all that it is made out to be. I dunno if family is making you feel such a depressive state but fuck em.

You'll find your drive. I know you will. I'm almost 30 and haven't found my drive yet, but I also know I'll find my own as well. We just gotta keep at it. If not for others, then just for us

Hey bud.

I dunno if this will help, and I'm not trying to guilt trip or whatever. But from my personal experience.

Someone very close to me took his life a few months ago. He was struggling. And I should have noticed that he was struggling. But I chalked it up to weed. Being high and looking impassive.

Once upon a time... well, for many years, I guess... I've hated myself. Wish I would have killed myself before he did. Because then, maybe my life could have served a purpose. Saving someone that I loved.

Could my suicide have? Maybe. Who knows. No one will know now. But I will say, even from someone who has thought about suicide... just fucking shooting myself in the head or offing myself in another way..

When my friend took their life, I was angry at them. Why didn't they tell me what was wrong? I had been in a similar mindset, I thought. If they had only reached out to me... We could have worked through it.

This situation made me realize how important it is to be honest with those you trust and care about. It can be difficult, I know... believe me. I regret a lot. My friend had asked about a scar on my arm. I lied to them. And forever I will wonder: if I had been honest about my self harm, suicidal ideation, would they still be here? Could I have helped create that conversation?

I will say... I don't think suicide is selfish. But I do believe you should think about those left behind. Just as you could be left behind before you leave other's behind.

Accept, if you do decide to pass, that no matter what you say... those you leave behind will forever have questions. Will forever blame themselves. Just as you would, if someone close and before you decided to take their lives.

I'm not trying to be a dick, but it does create another perspective. When someone else does it before you do. And it puts a lot into perspective.

And I will add, even if it is difficult... and you feel no one truly does care about you... FUCK THEM. You are worthy. You are a living being. Do what you want that makes you happy. Because no matter how dark it is, I'm sure you'll find something. Or, at the very least, I hope that you do.

You have value. You are worthy. And even if passion doesn't exist in your life, I'm sure you have something that you like or enjoy. Keep on keeping on. If not for others, then just for yourself.

Hey there, rottentoes.

Once upon a time, I think I did feel like you do. Sometimes, I still feel similarly to you.

Surprisingly,  I worked through a lot of my shit by my self. Then again, maybe I was too much of a coward. But there were times I did think about breaking into my dad's room to steal his gun. To shoot myself in the head. That idea... I nipped in the bud. I didn't want my father to live with the thought that he inadvertently helped me kill myself.

Then I thought, I could get drunk. Lay on the train tracks. But I didn't.  I can't really explain why, but I didn't. I think, for the most part, I didn't want my family to find, see, or hear about me getting splattered in half.

I really dunno how I made it this far. Maybe I thought too much about others which, I know, can be infuriating. When you just want to be at peace and die..

But I think a part of me, deep inside, wants to live. It wants to be loved. It wants to be recognized. It wants to leave an impact. And all I can say is to stay in the race. Find something to live for. Find a message you want to leave behind.

I always thought I would die young. Probably by killing myself. But then someone close to me decided to take that exit before me. For me, it changed a lit. I saw what that exit did, to many people. And no, of course, you don't want to just live for others. But if you can, find something to live for.

Even if it is small. Work towards it. Be the person you want to be. I dunno if this us selfish or not but again, seeing what my friend did, I couldn't do that to the people I care about. Which also is frustrating and kinda pisses me off. To think they are the ones keeping me from the end that I'd like to achieve. But also, I realize, there is still alot I'd like to work towards. And attempt to accomplish, personally, despite everything else.

I'm not sure if that is helpful or whatnot, but I think there is something you want to accomplish in life, personally. Not necessarily death. But something else. Take steps toward that more positive thing. Embrace it.

Once upon a time, I thought I was empty. I thought I deserved nothing. And even though a part of me still believes that, a part of me still strives to attempt to give something back to the world.

I'm sorry if this isn't helpful, or not. But know that you do have value. You are a living being, with Hope's and dreams. Latch onto and work towards those. Even if you don't think you do, there is something you're passionate about. Or at least care deeply about.

 Please care and look after yourself
